hero.title: Winter Courses in Finland
hero.subtitle: Finland offers international students opportunities to experience Nordic winter while participating in short-term academic programmes, intensive language classes, research-based learning and winter schools. These programmes are suitable for students who want to gain international exposure, develop new skills and experience Finnish culture during the winter season.
